verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal docs describe prebuilt email receipts that already include all card network-required fields. Merchants can also build custom receipts, such as printed ones, from Stripe API receipt data, as long as they list the required information. The docs confirm Terminal merchants must offer customers a physical or email receipt option. Missing for 10: SMS receipt delivery, a built-in printed-receipt capability (printing relies on custom receipts built from API data), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
